WITH circuit_averages AS (
  SELECT c."circuitId", c."country", AVG(r."round") AS avg_round
  FROM "circuits" AS c
  JOIN "races" AS r ON r."circuitId" = c."circuitId"
  GROUP BY c."circuitId", c."country"
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT "country", AVG(avg_round) AS country_avg_round
  FROM circuit_averages
  GROUP BY "country"
)
SELECT ca."circuitId", ca."country", ca.avg_round,
       ca.avg_round - coa.country_avg_round AS difference
FROM circuit_averages AS ca
JOIN country_averages AS coa ON coa."country" = ca."country"
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
